headline: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling cloud-native applications across fintech, banking, SaaS, and telecommunications. Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud infrastructure, with a track record of delivering highly available services and modernizing legacy platforms. Comfortable owning technical initiatives end-to-end: architecting systems, tuning performance, mentoring engineers, resolving production incidents, and AI engineering.

bullets: Led the architectural redesign of the company's cloud-based Web IDE around Docker-based containerized services, reducing cloud infrastructure costs by 20% while improving scalability and maintainability.
Integrated Stripe to support subscriptions, coupons, and regional pricing, enabling new pricing tiers and flexible monetization strategies.
Built high-throughput reactive streaming APIs using Spring WebFlux for AI-powered services, achieving sub-100 ms response latency while supporting over 5,000 concurrent streaming connections.
Built a collaborative code editing feature using Node.js, MongoDB, and Yjs, increasing user engagement by 25% through seamless multi-user collaboration.
Built concurrent backend services in Go using goroutines and channels, enabling efficient processing of high-volume workloads in a multi-threaded environment.
Integrated Azure Active Directory using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, improving secure access and streamlining user authentication workflows.
Developed a Python FastAPI service to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning for the "Vibing Code" tool.

Led the migration of a mission-critical SMS platform from a monolithic architecture to Java 17 microservices on Kubernetes, eliminating message delivery status loss during callback processing, accelerating deployment speed by 75%, and reducing monthly lost delivery status callbacks from over 1 million to zero.
Identified and resolved memory leaks using New Relic and heap analysis, reducing GC overhead and improving p90 latency from above 100ms to 45ms.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines with Buildkite, automating build, test, and deployment processes to enable reliable daily releases.
Directed root-cause analysis for high-priority production incidents, implementing permanent structural fixes that decreased recurring issues.
Built React-based single-page application features for the contact list management system.

Designed and implemented scalable event-driven Java/Kotlin microservices to automate BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) commission settlement workflow, replacing manual reconciliation with asynchronous message processing and improving processing reliability and operational accuracy.
Mentored junior engineers through pair programming, architecture discussions, and code reviews, contributing to their technical growth and career development.
Integrated the WhatsApp Business API to automate previously manual messaging workflows, replacing cellphone-based processes and significantly improving operational efficiency.
Developed and enhanced React-based single-page application (SPA) features for the BNPL management platform, delivering responsive, maintainable interfaces for merchant and operations teams.
Standardized API documentation using Swagger and ReadMe hosted portal, streamlining partner onboarding and API integration.
Developed Mastercard ISO 8583 pre-authorization capabilities for high-volume payment processing systems.
Implemented AES encryption for the POS simulator, ensuring PCI DSS compliance and improving the security and reliability of payment testing.
Built Splunk dashboards and proactive alerting, improving production observability and reducing mean time to detection (MTTD).
Increased backend test coverage to 80% by implementing comprehensive unit and integration tests, reducing production defects and improving release confidence.
Applied Clean Code principles and design patterns across backend services, improving code maintainability and accelerating onboarding for new engineers.
Developed RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot for an e-commerce platform.
Improved application performance through targeted caching strategies and database query optimization, reducing API response latency.
Integrated Slack webhook notifications into operational workflows, improving production monitoring and reducing incident response time.

Provisioned and managed Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure using Terraform, developing reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules to enable consistent, version-controlled deployments across environments.
Developed backend functionality for financial processing systems using Java and mainframe technologies.
Executed and maintained batch jobs supporting daily financial transactions.
Resolved frontend defects using JavaScript and jQuery in support of legacy production systems.
